title: Taiwan Dollar: CBC seen on hold before December hike – DBS
summary: DBS Group Research expects Taiwan’s central bank to keep its policy rate unchanged on September 17, before raising it to 2.125% in December.

title: Crude Oil buckles early and grinds back on talk of a Hormuz arrangement
summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) trades near $97.00, about 3.4% lower and on track for its first down session in five.

title: White House Weighs Defense Production Act as U.S. Refineries Maxed Out
summary: The White House is considering using the Defense Production Act to add U.S. refining capacity, with American refineries already running at 98% capacity and diesel prices above $6 per gallon for the first time. The proposal was discussed during President Donald Trump’s recent meeting with nearly a dozen U.S. refiners, according to Reuters. No decision has been made, and discussions are expected to continue.
